concept: Stateless: move session state to ElastiCache/DynamoDB
tests: How to stop users being logged out on scale-in when sessions are stored in instance memory.
expected: Store session state in ElastiCache or DynamoDB — the web tier becomes stateless. Triggers: "session state in instance memory", "logouts when instances scale in".
why_not: Sticky sessions still lose state when an instance terminates; disabling Auto Scaling removes elasticity; a bigger instance doesn't fix the problem.
